parts.prompt: Prove that the two curves do not intersect and identify which is higher on each side of their common pole.
parts.answer: No intersections; C₂ is higher for x > −3 and lower for x < −3.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find and classify the stationary points of \(C_2\).

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: Sketch both curves on one set of axes. You need not find the x-intercepts of \(C_2\).
parts.answer: Use the two asymptotes at infinity, the common pole and the proven ordering.
